positions.title: Software Developer (Server / Android)
positions.description:
●	Implemented server side push notification features for IOS and Android devices.
●	Responsible for supporting, maintaining, and incorporating features for Restful Web services utilized by client devices (IOS, Android, and Win8).
●	Collaborated with cross-functional teams in fast paced Agile Development environment to design and create features to fulfill business requirements.
●	Designed and initiated a system to extract and resize raw PDF/XML content from the publisher into specified format that meet project goals for content team.
●	Developed a multi-threading scheduler in spring framework to protect content on CDN and securely transport files from one repository to another.
●	Production support.
●	Part of the Android team, responsible for adding features and optimize current app.

positions.title: Accelerated program for Android development
positions.description:
WhereToEat - https://github.com/wheretoeatorg/WhereToEat

Developed WhereToEat, it is an app to find food and/or drinks around you, without having to search / select too many options with the best and limited results to make up your mind easily.

It also provides the informations (like website, phone number, directions to the place and reviews from other users).
